market_overview: The technical landscape is mixed. Canadian equities and several US ETFs show bullish weekly signals and leading RRG quadrants, indicating risk‑on bias, while many symbols sit below their 18‑day MA and a number of lagging instruments (e.g., RBOT, XMA.TO) temper optimism. Bonds display a blend of above‑MA strength with weakening RRG, and commodities/alternatives are largely risk‑off, below MA and flagged Watch. Overall the market leans neutral with pockets of upside in select equities and bonds and defensive pressure in commodities.
